title: Cao Bang in two days
summary: Night one for the falls, night two for a different road. The second day is Phia Oac, a full day west, or Pac Bo, a half day north. Do not put the falls on both.

days.title: Ban Gioc, the cave, and the pagoda
days.body: Sleep in Dam Thuy, or leave Cao Bang city early. Ban Gioc, Nguom Ngao, and Truc Lam Ban Gioc share the eastern valley. Nguom Ngao is about 4 km from the falls. How long you stay is Check on arrival.

days.title: Phia Oac or Pac Bo
days.body: Choose one. Phia Oac is a full day west, up to a 1,935 m summit. Pac Bo is a half day north, about 55 km on provincial road 203. Drive minutes are Check on arrival.

stops.name: Ban Gioc Waterfall
stops.note: See the falls on the first day, with the cave and the pagoda.

stops.name: Nguom Ngao Cave
stops.note: Walk the lit cave, about 4 km from the falls.

stops.name: Truc Lam Ban Gioc Pagoda
stops.note: Climb the short steep path to the viewpoint above the falls.

stops.name: Phia Oac–Phia Den National Park
stops.note: Give the second day to the west road and the moss forest.

additions.name: Pac Bo
additions.note: Use the second day for Pac Bo when you are not going west.

seoDescription: Two days in Cao Bang: Ban Gioc with the cave and the pagoda, then Phia Oac or Pac Bo. The roads leave town in different directions.
